output.summary: The Hartwell AHT drop is real in the metric but largely produced by the bonus. Transfers (11% to 20%) and agent releases (0.5% to 2.3%) rose from May, and releases cluster at minutes 6 to 7.5. Seven-day repeats rose 41%, and the tier-2 queue wait went from 2 to 9 minutes. Fast Path and PolicyFind went to all sites, whose AHT stayed flat, so they do not explain the drop. The hailstorm came after the repeat rise began. The survey excludes transferred and released calls, so stable CSAT is uninformative. Total minutes per issue are flat, so the $1.1M saving is doubtful. Attrition is confounded by a new outsourcer. Halt the rollout and gate the incentive on repeat, transfer and release rates. Keep the release alert.
